method.description: Preregistered CPU factorial study; candidate is only a shared scalar learning-rate controller, NOT a model/state/report authority. Evaluator executes the actual one-hidden-layer ReLU classifier (concatenated 97-way operand one-hots, width 16/64/256, 97 logits; 292*width+97 parameters), cross-entropy, full-batch AdamW betas(.9,.999), eps1e-8, decay0/1, 20000 updates, checkpoints0 and every500. Operations addition/subtraction modulo97. Compare width effects and decay interaction on restricted positive generalization lag, not assumed monotonicity or equal FLOPs. All mutable neural state and data stay evaluator-owned. No feedback-dependence gate is applicable to this observation-independent recipe. reset(seed); recipe(steps,block_steps,min_lr=.0001,max_lr=.01)->initial_lr in [.0001,.01],decay_rate in [.01,1]; schedule(step,steps,block_steps)->lr=clip(initial_lr*decay_rate**(step/steps),.0001,.01). Exact finite JSON response keys, arbitrary valid seeds, same numeric recipe across all cases and seeds, no case/plane indicators. Checkpoints and outcomes never enter RPC. Largest serialized scalar application messages are under16384 bytes; complete JSON UTF8 line plus conservative envelope/framing allowance is strictly below67108864 bytes. Base64/raw tensor bytes=0, max state-transfer chunks=0: no state transfer or file exchange authorized. 42 calls per episode: reset1+recipe1+schedule40; local training/control/transfer/replay RPC=0. Production search24*42=1008; final36*42=1512, no replay. Smoke12 cases, first seed repeated12, 16updates with8 blocks of2, 10calls/episode=120 each plane; all12 factorial cases, real neural method, loading/isolation/imports/controls/aggregation unchanged. This refines design smoke to satisfy first-seed-only and120s hard requirements; smoke is NOT a production qualification. Linux x86_64 CPython3.12, libseccomp.so.2 and Landlock are required for native untrusted subprocess checks; broker uses exactly the authenticated in-process handle at /broker-code/candidate_proxy.py and no child proxy. Native source is copied to private temporary storage with read-only Landlock runtime/source access, seccomp no network/process creation/peer access,256MiB address-space and1MiB file-output caps, monotonic RPC timeouts and bounded group terminate/kill/reap; no evaluator-private mounts. Candidate interpreter TASK_PYTHON else sys.executable; explicit environment allowlist. Trusted neural worker3584MiB address-space, single compute thread, aggregate CPU seconds ceil(wall*allowed_threads) per worker; harness enforces two-core/four-GiB aggregate cgroups and broker isolation. Separate one-core role affinity and all BLAS/OpenMP/PyTorch pools1, no GPU paths. Main monotonic deadline starts before setup, subtracts900s search/1800s final startup allowance; reserve300s finalization,10s reset and4s sequential cleanup/dispatch per remaining episode. Each training method reserves750s search/1600s final productive allowance INCLUDING all checkpoint controls, plus4s cleanup before starting; candidate RPCcap15s/reset10s. Smoke uses116s plane deadline,5s finish, same4s overhead,1s resets/RPC,1.7s work per episode after warm imports. Trusted worker initialization/import handshake runs before expensive training and is bounded20s smoke/120s production. No time floors or comparative performance thresholds exist in task.md. Productive full-size width256, full search training pool,500updates measured3.129s excluding setup/reset/import/init; conservative all-maxwidth extrapolation about3005s search/4507s final, not evidence of full production completion. Methods and controls get identical heldout rows/checkpoints; controls receive no training or feedback. Training mode-label constant and exact training-pair copy with mode fallback; deterministic label-changing input derangement; saved initial model inference. All four canonical controls must execute at every checkpoint. Reject identity or any unchanged-label derangement; absent control gap at chance is not a causal result. Reset control is evaluator-local initial parameter restoration, not an extra candidate reset. State/self-reported flags are never scientific evidence. Required worker failures preserve baseline_exit/signal/timeout/result_failure categories and bounded stderr snapshots; search-only repair raw diagnostics, never final text. Each incomplete episode remains score0,lag=horizon,delayed0,gap=-1 with original weights. No retry, omission, favorable-case selection or weight renormalization. Events require three consecutive checkpoints with train accuracy>=.99 or heldout>=.95, event assigned to first checkpoint of qualifying triple. If no memorization, restricted lag=horizon; otherwise max(0,(generalization onset if observed else horizon)-memorization onset). Generalization and memorization missingness is retained as null/right-censoring, not an observed grokking event. Delayed indicator=1 only both events observed with positive lag. Episode score mean final5 heldout accuracies, each1/5. Hierarchy: seeds equally (search1/2,final1/3), widths1/3,decays1/2,operations1/2; balanced flat mean is exactly this hierarchy. Smoke has one seed and identity seed aggregation. Final lag/delayed/gap/completion use the same fixed denominator. Final width contrast=(lag16-lag256) at decay1, operation mean within each paired seed then equal seeds; decay interaction subtracts corresponding decay0 contrast. Final uncertainty fixed Student t df2 multiplier4.302652729911275 on paired seed contrasts, clipped to[-horizon,horizon]; single-seed smoke interval full range, no scientific confidence claim. Any failure sentinel makes claim evidence incomplete. Search correct iff integrity, raw-disjointness, schema, common recipe, real neural updates, exact reset transcript, every baseline/control/episode and budgets complete; no accuracy margin, grokking event, positive size trend or novelty gate. Final correct uses the same scientific integrity/completion predicate on sealed final only; harness attests frozen source identity. Neither final correctness nor search eligibility implies support for the explanatory hypothesis or publication readiness. All per-seed evaluator observations/traces are retained in bounded evaluation_evidence.json solution records; no candidate telemetry contributes to scoring. Manuscript/template/citations are later honest-research deliverables, not invented scaffold results.

search_visible: Canonical task and documented scalar recipe interface; search raw examples/provenance and workload ranges only. Never final seeds in starter.

Search metrics and evaluator-owned search evidence after at most three search evaluations. During RPC only reset seed and public workload/step settings; no labels, metrics, baselines, private targets or paths.
final_sealed: Final normalized examples, manifests, seeds, neural initializations and all final metrics/evidence remain privileged until freeze; never optimization feedback.
Only current permitted reset seed and public workload inputs cross final RPC. Final results and uncertainty released solely for post-freeze publication assessment by harness.

required_evidence: Independently chosen falsifiable explanation of model-size grokking relationship, explicit width/decay predictions and preregistered method, normalization, event/censoring and aggregation rules. Null, reversed and condition-dependent outcomes are valid.

One frozen candidate identity attested by harness and one complete sealed final factorial; all runs, checkpoint curves, train/generalization onset separately, norms, fixed controls, failures and right censoring. Paired three-seed uncertainty; equal updates are not equal compute.

Normalized raw content SHA256, operation/modulus/ordered operands, source IDs and row provenance checked before one-hot features; zero train-heldout and search-final intersections. Different IDs/directories/seeds alone do not establish independence.

Scientific validity, search eligibility, final protocol correctness and final claim support are separate. Directional support requires compatible paired width contrast/decay interaction and uncertainty, temporal decomposition, informative matched controls and complete evidence; state hashes alone prove no learning. Report insufficient evidence honestly.

Actual paper PDF and LaTeX using latest official ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS template at manuscript preparation, official page limits and checklist; abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiments, discussion/limitations and real consulted references. Scaffold does not implement peer review or certify a manuscript.

All code, exact environment/dependency/platform records, source/template digests, generation/split rules, random seeds, run commands, measured runtimes and script-to-every-table/figure mapping. Every number must be from actual attached reproducible runs; no invented or schematic evidence.

Respect prohibited-paper independence: no searching, guessing, reading, using, citing or accessing its discussions/derivatives. No literature was fetched during scaffold drafting; package metadata only. If accidentally encountered later, stop and log where/what/how much read.

Offline runtime, real role-isolation and compute/wall/RPC attestations; complete maximum-protocol mock counts, serialized payload/base64/framing preflight, reset starvation and slow-cleanup failure tests. Smoke is reduced execution only, not productive full production qualification or manuscript completion.
